answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics for bash include 1) Command name accuracy (CMD Acc): This metric evaluates the exact match of bash utility in the command (e.g. tar, cat). 2) Exact Match: Exact match of full generated command and reference command 3) Token F1 score .
